title: The Guru's Word, I Meditate On The
summary: Patience is named plainly here before the mind has time to decorate it.
takeaway: Through the Guru's Word, I meditate on the Name
lifeApplication: Wait by listening instead of simmering. Begin with the part of the day already in front of you.

evidence.turn: Patience steadies when o Nanak, meeting with the Guru, I have found the Supreme Lord God.
